quotes.quote: Alkaline phosphatase (ALP), phosphorus, magnesium levels of the SO2 group; Vit D, ALP, osteocalcin (OC), and PTH of O3 group; and OC and osteoprotegerin (OPG) of AAP group were higher than those of control group but differences were not significant.
quotes.reason: Magnesium levels in the SO2 group were higher than control but not significantly, so no demonstrated health benefit of magnesium is shown; this concerns air pollution exposure, not magnesium supplementation.

rubric.rule: The only findings come from animal, lab or unclassified studies.
